correctness.rationale: In any original neighbor force from an initially empty pair, the forcing vertex has its private leaf initially blue; otherwise it cannot force an original until all original neighbors already blue. Thus a successful forcing chronology defines an injective donor assignment with an acyclic predecessor graph, exactly a uniquely restricted matching; reversing the acyclic order forces every empty pair. Enumeration is disjoint by D,U and the clique minimality proof checks each deletion. Direct ordinary closure versus derived cut test: 500260 instances; matching-versus-peeling enumerated directly in 5421 cases; polynomial and minimal-set comparisons pass in verify.py output.

value.rationale: A complete exact multivariate cut-parameter sum produces the zero forcing polynomial of every graph after attaching a private leaf at each vertex. For a natural and previously studied whiskered clique, it evaluates every coefficient and distinguishes minimum and inclusion-minimal zero forcing sets in closed form, including a new size-n minimal set and an explicit counterexample to the published mixed-family minimality assertion. No polynomial-time complexity claim or arbitrary slice gain is needed.
